llm.summary: CellCog provides a coherent delegation service, but its optional browser, computer, and connected-account access needs clearer limits and user authorization.

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md lines 239–273 enable the user's real Chrome profile and connected accounts, document that browsing automatically enables co-work, and allow every connected toolkit when tools_selection is omitted. These sensitive capabilities lack a required task-specific authorization step or restrictions separating reading from modification. The email example narrows access to Gmail, but the file-upload privacy warning does not cover account access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses an unpinned pip upgrade of cellcog or the disclosed MCP connector. The linked [publisher repository](https://github.com/CellCog/cellcog_python) and [PyPI listing](https://pypi.org/project/cellcog/) corroborate the SDK and integrations. No executable payload is bundled.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation description is broad, but it does not require delegating every task. Browser, workspace, and account integrations are disclosed in the body, so the advisory description-mismatch claims overstate hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Background notifications, tasks continuing after timeouts, and long-lived AI employees are disclosed. Task cancellation is illustrated, and employee pause/delete controls are available through the website. These features fit delegation rather than demonstrating covert persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Remote research, content creation, file uploads, and downloads fit the stated purpose. Uploads are explicitly disclosed. The support destination is a placeholder chat ID, and API-key setup provides no evidence of credential theft.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use CellCog for tasks you intend to delegate externally. Before enabling browser, computer, or account access, explicitly approve the task and resources, select only necessary toolkits, and establish whether changes are allowed. Browsing also enables co-work. Share only intended files, review credit usage, and stop ongoing tasks or employees when finished. The concern is insufficient access scoping, not demonstrated malicious behavior.
